title: ImageRepresentationUseV1
description: Proposed asset-scoped association between an intended usage and one technical ImageRepresentationV1. Usage semantics are contextual metadata and are deliberately kept outside ImageRepresentationV1. Provenance such as original or derived is a separate concern and is not represented by purpose. This schema is not yet canonical.

purpose.description: Application-defined intended use of this representation within the asset, for example display or thumbnail. This describes usage context, not provenance.
